extracted.intended_audience: readers of Popular Science Monthly — educated general readers, students and scholars considering scientific/economic/literary books
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and evaluative principles used in magazine book reviews and literary notices for judging the quality, usefulness, and production of scholarly and popular books across science, economics, and literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and succinctness
rubrics_metrics.description: The work should present a clear, succinct, and dispassionate account of its subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Valued especially for contested or technical subjects (e.g., palaeontological knowledge). A clear and succinct descriptive presentation, independent of disputed theories, helps general readers grasp key facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality and judicial tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Impartial in its statements and judicial in its conclusions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid partisan or one-sided treatment; fairly present opposed views. Reviewers praise works that display fairness and moderated judgment rather than polemic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness and exactness
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive outline and full, clear, and exact explanations of the subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover the main principles and leading facts sufficiently; include necessary detail so readers can rely on the work as an authoritative guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Up-to-dateness
rubrics_metrics.description: Brought up to date; includes recent works and developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In fast-moving fields, note and incorporate the latest literature (the review praises books that reference works appearing even while the volume was being prepared).

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning and scholarship
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows varied and accurate learning; author is thoroughly conversant with the subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evidence of careful labor and scholarship is important — use of authoritative sources, accurate facts, and knowledgeable synthesis are praised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization and classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject is well classified and organized into clear divisions (parts/chapters) that bring out likenesses and differences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow space to classify and elaborate details; a logical structure aids comprehension and comparative understanding (example: three general divisions in a monetary treatise).

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustrations and production quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Profuse and elegant illustrations; artists execute faithful pictorial representations; overall good production (indexing, layout, binding).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-quality illustrations and professional production enhance the book's usefulness and appeal. 'Well gotten up' production and a copious index are singled out as merits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography, appendix, glossary, and index
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of copious bibliography, convenient appendices (tabulated statistics), glossary of technical terms, and a full index.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These reference aids are essential for scholarly utility and for readers seeking further study or data; their presence is an explicit positive point in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions and careful use of terminology
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical terms are defined; author justifies or refines key terminology (e.g., substituting terms with reasons given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define terms used and explain terminological choices to avoid confusion (the review praises clear definitions and reasoned replacements of terms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility to intended audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The presentation should be popular and comprehensible or tailored appropriately to students and general readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance technical detail with readability so the book meets the needs of its target audience — e.g., being suitable for both psychological students and general readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone and readability (avoid long-windedness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid being long-winded, dull, or straying into obscure metaphysics; maintain readable style and spirit where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbose or wandering exposition is a fault ('rather long-winded, a trifle dull'); lively, spirited writing is commended when it conveys subject matter effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectivity on controversial issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate descriptive facts from contested theories and maintain a dispassionate account in controversial areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When dealing with debates, present descriptive material independently of speculative or contested theorizing; dispassionate treatment increases trustworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical usefulness and timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: The book should offer practical lessons, timely discussion, or clear guidance applicable to current public or scholarly concerns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works that 'clear away the fogs' on pressing issues or provide timely, common-sense treatments (e.g., monetary questions) are especially valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value for money / cost consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration of price and whether the book's cost is moderate or appropriate for its intended market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moderate cost and wide accessibility (price relative to content/production) are favorable; reviewers note and weigh price alongside quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality versus synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Original contribution is desirable but not essential; thorough synthesis and fair presentation of existing material are valuable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A work 'covers no new ground' is not necessarily disparaged if it is impartial, comprehensive, and well presented — synthesis can be a strength when novelty is elusive.
